packageRules.description: Apply a 3-day minimum release age to NPM dependencies by default, for security purposes.
Remove minimum release age for internal @turo namespaced packages, and other trusted and/or safe exceptions.
Reduce age gate to 3 days to 1 day day for specific packages, where we want to update much more frequently, and especially do not expect security risk.
Reduce age gate from 3 days to 2 days for specific packages, where we want to update somewhat more frequently, and do not expect security risk.
